PURPOSE: Adversarial certification mechanism for ORCA missions: clean-room re-derivation of Patronus AI's evaluation/simulation run structure (scenario, agent under test, judge/scorer, verdict) as PING primitives. Delivers the VerdictReceipt record shape and fail-closed gating semantics that proofs 9-14 require (injected bad result rejected, VERIFIED only after independent verification).
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: VerdictReceipt: canonical content-addressed record {verdict_id, attempt_id, evaluator_id, criteria_id, judge_id, judge_version, score, pass, reasoning_ref, evaluated_at} binding an independent judge's observation to a mission attempt; missing/UNKNOWN verdict can never satisfy a VERIFIED transition; adversarial control cases (injected_fault) fail the run if a known-bad output is passed.
